toolCall.title: Question: Which auth method should the API use?

questions.question: Which auth method should the API use?

options.label: OAuth 2.0
options.description: Delegated sign-in through the identity provider; best for third-party clients.

options.label: API keys
options.description: One static key per integration. Simple, but keys must be rotated by hand.

options.label: Passkeys
options.description: WebAuthn credentials bound to the device. No shared secret on the server.
